meta.description: Curated starter dataset of Bangladesh-relevant smartphones released roughly in the last two years, hand-compiled from general public knowledge as a bootstrap for the Phone Kinbo pipeline. This is NOT a manufacturer or retailer feed - every record is routed to the review queue (see config/phone_sources.php: seed_dataset.requires_review) so a human confirms specs and current Bangladesh pricing before anything here is treated as authoritative.
